p: And so there was truly born then
For just as there was born in this world
a soul that would be fit
כֵּן נוֹלַד נֶפֶשׁ וְרוּחַ שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ
so was born the nefesh and ruach of Mashiach,
which is born through the coupling
and union of Ze'ir and his Nukva,
to which the two Keruvim allude.
And this is why the Keruvim were immediately
of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah.
on Tisha B'Av Mashiach is born;
for in every generation there is one soul
that is fit to be Mashiach,
that they disagreed in the Gemara (Sanhedrin 98b):
that is fit to be Mashiach,
if the generation would be worthy
And regarding the days of Mashiach
"And it shall come to pass afterward
that I will pour out My spirit," etc.,
"and You sanctified it above all the times";
all the holiness of the festive times;
and as is written in the holy Zohar
for Shabbos includes all the blessings
וְכָל מַה שֶּׁיֵּשׁ בְּתוֹךְ יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה
and whatever blessing and holiness there is
receives from the day of Shabbos
on the Shabbos before Rosh Chodesh;
for the holiness of Rosh Chodesh,
is included in the preceding Shabbos
and receives from the day of Shabbos.
the day of the destruction of the House of our God
is not included in the preceding Shabbos,
"the sum of all blessings and holinesses."
But that the day of Tisha B'Av
of the nefesh and ruach of Mashiach
this is included in this Shabbos
And therefore this Shabbos is called
for on it Mashiach is fit to be born,
